summary: Completed testing of Avatar Scene Feature for Scormify AI Course Platform. All 11 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verification confirmed all avatar scene components working correctly including avatar settings panel, avatar_scene type improvements with violet styling, narration script preview, and background description display.
critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: GET /api/agent/projects/{project_id}/avatar-settings returns default {maxScenes: 3} for projects without settings
GOOD: PUT /api/agent/projects/{project_id}/avatar-settings correctly updates maxScenes, defaultAvatarId, defaultVoiceId
GOOD: GET /api/agent/projects/{project_id}/avatar-generation-status returns 'no_pending' when no avatar scenes generating
GOOD: POST /api/agent/courses/{project_id}/analyze returns improvements array that may include type 'avatar_scene' with narrationScript, backgroundDescription, avatarPosition fields
GOOD: POST /api/agent/courses/{project_id}/apply-improvements returns avatarScenesTriggered count in response
GOOD: Frontend CourseReviewPanel shows avatar settings (expandable) with 'Configurações de Avatar' section
GOOD: Frontend avatar_scene type improvements display with violet styling (border-violet-800/30, bg-violet-950/20)
GOOD: Frontend typeLabels includes 'Cena com Avatar' for avatar_scene type
GOOD: Frontend shows narration script preview in violet-themed box with 'SCRIPT DE NARRAÇÃO' header
GOOD: Frontend shows background description with Image icon below narration script
GOOD: Avatar limit input (data-testid='avatar-limit-input') allows configuring max scenes per course

context_for_next_testing_agent: Avatar Scene Feature fully tested and working.
